relations.rationale: Sami's laughter at a mishap is unrelated to Vik's grinning during the race.
Sami's reaction to a broken axle has no bearing on the group discussing future sessions.
The noise of motors and clapping filling the room is consistent with and suggests teams racing machines down the corridor, supporting that such racing was occurring.
Teams racing their machines describes the competition Vik reportedly enjoyed most, supporting the plausibility of his enjoyment.
Teams racing down the corridor is the context in which Vik's robot could be inching ahead, supporting that scenario.
Vik enjoying the competition most is directly supported by his grinning as his robot advanced.
Vik enjoying the competition most does not indicate he ranked fastest; Kai is stated as fastest, so this is unrelated to enjoyment.
Vik grinning as his robot inched ahead suggests he was doing well, which could contradict Kai being fastest overall if Vik was leading.
Kai ranking fastest overall is compatible with everyone agreeing the ranking differences were small, supporting that the margins were close despite a clear winner.
Both describe the group working together as the workshop wound down, so packing away tools supports the general cooperative winding-down activity including sweeping.
Packing away tools together is unrelated to whether the group was already discussing the next session.
Sweeping the floor together is unrelated to the group's conversation about the next session.
